text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
After all the support from everyone in 
Hidaka, 
I can't even face them like this...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Every competitor is so strong. 
It truly is a harsh world after all...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That's why I need to sharpen my running 
even more 
and adapt to this environment!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To win the next race, I believe 
I need special training.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Secluding myself in the mountains... no, 
placing myself 
in an even harsher environment might be 
better...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
choice_data_list: Let's calm down for a second.

I'll put together a special training menu 
for you!

I'll put together a special training menu 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
choice_data_list: Let's calm down for a second.

I'll put together a special training menu 
for you!

I'll put together a special training menu 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, you're right. 
First, I need to reflect on today's 
race...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even this defeat is a precious learning 
experience. 
It would be a waste not to turn it into 
fuel.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I need to use everything at my disposal to 
grow— 
so I can bring victory back home to 
everyone in Hidaka!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. 
Please, make my regimen as tough as 
possible!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's waterfall meditation, trail 
running, 
or even a full marathon of frog jumps... 
I promise I'll see it all through.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'll rebuild myself from the ground up, 
and next time, victory will be ours!
